_comment: Committed EXPECTATION for the prebuilt libghostty-vt.a. zig-shim.sh refuses to build unless the vendored source tree still hashes to vendor_tree_sha256. Regenerated by .github/workflows/frontera-libghostty-vt.yml; update it in a deliberate, reviewed commit -- never automatically.
vendor_tree_digest_cmd: export LC_ALL=C; find vendor/libghostty-vt \( -name zig-out -o -name .zig-cache -o -name zig-cache \) -prune -o -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum
vendor_tree_digest_note: LC_ALL must be EXPORTED, not used as a command prefix: 'LC_ALL=C find ... | sort' applies the locale only to find, leaving sort under the ambient locale and yielding a different digest. Verified: the two forms disagree on this tree.
zig_argv_note: Mirrors build.rs's own invocation, with two Frontera-specific additions. build.rs emits -Dtarget=x86_64-linux-gnu (UNVERSIONED); zig's default glibc for that triple is 2.28, newer than Frontera's 2.17, so the .2.17 suffix is load-bearing. -Dcpu=baseline is redundant given that an explicit -Dtarget already resolves cpu to Target.Cpu.baseline, but it makes the invariant self-documenting.
